comments.content: update_build_config dynamically injects `clean_data` into build_config but `clean_data` is not declared in `inputs`. This makes the field invisible to the component schema and `self.clean_data` will only exist if passed via kwargs, leading to inconsistent UI/state and potential AttributeError. Declare it as a conditional input or manage it via build_config only.

_clean_args rejects Message/str/list inputs and raises 'Unsupported input type' for them, yet `parse_combined_text` calls `_clean_args` before `convert_to_string` when `stringify=True`. `_validate_input` and `_safe_convert` explicitly support Message/str/list, so `test_stringify_message_object` and stringify with non-DataFrame/Data inputs will fail. Bypass `_clean_args` for the stringify path or make `_clean_args` accept the types validated later.

For Data objects `parse_combined_text` hardcodes `template.format(text=data.get_text())`. This forces the placeholder name to be `text` and ignores the user-provided template for Data, e.g. a template like `{value}` will raise KeyError. Use the Data's actual fields or document the restriction and validate the template against available keys.
